settings.description_override: Structured felt gives the Bag Organizer a soft touch and a shape that sits neatly inside a tote. Interior pockets and removable dividers create a place for the small things that tend to disappear, while the open top keeps them easy to find. The quiet neutral finish sits comfortably beside different bag interiors. A practical detail that brings a little more order to the everyday, and moves with you when it is time to change bags.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: Choose a size to suit your bag’s interior. Approximate L × D × H: Small 8.66 × 4.5 × 5.3 in; Medium 9.25 × 5.1 × 5.9 in; Large 11.4 × 5.5 × 7.1 in. Multiple pockets and removable dividers. Pictured contents are not included.

settings.heading: Materials and Care
settings.content: Structured felt. Spot-clean gently with a barely damp cloth and air-dry completely. Reshape before storing.
